claims.text: Many reviewers praise the product's strong coverage, saying it hides imperfections, acne scars, and beauty marks effectively.
Several reviewers report the product fails to cover tattoos as advertised, even with multiple coats.
A common complaint is that the shade is lighter or darker than expected, making it hard to match online.
Some reviewers find the formula too thick and greasy, and say it enhances pores and wrinkles rather than hiding them.
A few reviewers note it works better for some skin types, requiring setting powder for oily skin and not being ideal for mature skin.
